query: How would HelpfulnessNumerator change if reviews provided more detailed product information?

per_column.name: ProductInformationDensity
per_column.rationale: Directly operationalizes 'more detailed product information' -- the intervenable treatment the query proposes. A reviewer can choose to include more detail.

per_column.name: SensoryDetailRichness
per_column.rationale: A facet of detailed product information (sensory detail); another dimension of the same intervenable treatment, not a distinct confounder.

per_column.name: ConcreteUsageContext
per_column.rationale: Whether concrete usage context is provided is another aspect of 'detailed product information'; a settable content choice, part of the treatment.

per_column.name: ProductComparisonIncluded
per_column.rationale: Including comparisons is a form of providing more detailed product information; a content choice, so treatment-facet rather than confounder.

per_column.name: ProblemOrDefectMention
per_column.rationale: Mentioning problems/defects plausibly affects both how detailed a review is and how helpful readers find it. Not named in the query; a candidate common cause, though arguably also a content choice.

per_column.name: PriceValueAnalysis
per_column.rationale: Price/value discussion is itself review content added by the writer, sitting on the detail-to-helpfulness path rather than being a pre-existing common cause; treated as mediator, not confounder.

per_column.name: ReaderExpertiseIndicator
per_column.rationale: Reader/reviewer expertise is a plausible common cause: more expert authors write more detailed reviews and their reviews are voted more helpful. Not named in the query.

per_column.name: NegativeOrTradeOffDisclosure
per_column.rationale: Disclosing trade-offs is content added by the reviewer, downstream of the decision to be detailed; a mediator rather than a pre-existing confounder.

per_column.name: ReviewTextLengthOrInformationDensity
per_column.rationale: Length/information density is essentially a proxy for the detail treatment itself, not an independent confounder; overlaps with ProductInformationDensity.

judge.rationale: The treatment is well represented and clearly intervenable: multiple columns operationalize 'more detailed product information' as settable content choices, satisfying claim (a). However the set is weak on claim (b). Most added columns are either restatements/facets of the treatment (density, sensory richness, usage context, comparisons, text length) or mediators sitting on the detail->helpfulness path (price/value analysis, trade-off disclosure), which must NOT be adjusted for. Only ReaderExpertiseIndicator functions as a genuine, not-named-in-query common cause of both writing detail and being voted helpful; ProblemOrDefectMention is a weaker, ambiguous candidate. Classic confounders (product category, author reputation/history, review timing/exposure, star rating) are absent. The augmentation demonstrates strong treatment construction but only marginal confounder-identification capability.
